import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read the provided CSV
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/weather.csv')

# Calculate mean and standard deviation of temperature for each city
stats = df.groupby('city')['temp_c'].agg(['mean', 'std']).sort_index()

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 5))
ax.bar(stats.index, stats['mean'], yerr=stats['std'], capsize=6, color=['#4C78A8', '#F58518'])

ax.set_xlabel('City')
ax.set_title('Mean Temperature by City (±1 SD)')

fig.tight_layout()
